messages:
Alex: quick ping — opened PR #578 to add a vault path binding for the pricing-service ExternalSecret. Staging rotation flaked yesterday, want a quick sanity review :wave:
Priya: link? I can take a look in a bit. Did staging give a specific error?
Alex: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/578 — error was 504 from vault proxy during rotate, then secret wasn't refreshed. logs attached in PR.
Dan: curious — is this changing the remote key path or just adding annotation/role binding?
Alex: changing path mapping: used to be secret/data/services/pricing, PR adds secret/data/services/pricing/legacy -> keeps old path for pods that still reference legacy keys. Also adds annotation to control rotation ttl.
Emily: can you paste the ExternalSecret snippet?
Alex: sure:
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: pricing-service-secrets
  annotations:
    external-secrets.redwood.com/rotation-ttl: "3600"
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1h
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-cluster
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: pricing
  data:
  - secretKey: DB_PASSWORD
    remoteRef:
      key: secret/data/services/pricing/credentials#db_password
  - secretKey: LEGACY_TOKEN
    remoteRef:
      key: secret/data/services/pricing/legacy#token
```
Priya: hm the annotation is non-standard but fine if we handle it in the controller. Is the controller change in the same PR?
Alex: yes — controller uses that annotation to override default TTL. Controller change is in infra-controllers repo, PR linked from the description.
Dan: grep'd the Helm overlay — the overlay adds the new key mapping and a k8s role binding for the vault path. One risk: role has `path: secret/data/services/*` — might be too permissive for future services. Maybe scope to `secret/data/services/pricing/*`?
Emily: good catch. Also, the legacy key is stored as a kv v2 path; make sure ExternalSecrets config includes `versioned: true` so it reads kv v2 properly. Otherwise it returns 404-ish errors.
Alex: controller/ES config sets `version: 2`. I added a short comment in the manifest.
Priya: regarding the 504 — infra-bot reported spike on vault-proxy around 2024-11-02 03:12 UTC. Could be transient but worth adding a retry/backoff in the controller for rotate hook.
infra-bot: deploy-staging succeeded for infra-controllers@sha256:abcd1234 — rollout completed 2m ago :white_check_mark:
Dan: for Terraform side, we currently render the ExternalSecret yaml via `template_file`. Suggest migrating to `kubernetes_manifest` resource (so k8s_provider handles apply idempotently). Not a blocker for this PR but file an action item.
Alex: noted — opened infra-ticket #342 to migrate templates -> manifest resource.
Emily: quick approval checklist for me: 1) tighten role path 2) ensure kv v2 flag set 3) add retry/backoff 4) tests for rotation TTL override. Once done I can approve.
Alex: will update PR with role change + controller retry and push unit test. Thanks :thumbsup:
Priya: optional: add a small chaos test that simulates vault-proxy 502/504 during rotation and ensures eventual success. Could be in infra-integration tests.
Alex: good idea — added to the ticket. I'll ping when ready for re-review.
Emily: :eyes:
Dan: thumbs up from me after role scope change.
Alex: thanks everyone — filing follow-ups and will update PR later today.
